audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma's grounding was described with no cooldown; Twin Fang's healing and cast rate were never stated; wants.foe[1] said Petrifying Gaze roots.
audit.why: Miasma (W) is 24/22/20/18/16 and grounds — it is the only thing that turns off Urchin Strike and Playful/Trickster. Twin Fang (E) fires on a 0.75s cooldown and heals off the damage, which is why anti-heal decides extended trades. Petrifying Gaze stuns enemies facing her; it does not root.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 24s/16s Miasma and 0.75s Twin Fang with the Grievous Wounds call; wants.foe[1] now reads stun.
